import numpy as np
import mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from PIL import Image

class Control:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s; self.m=s.model; self.d=s.data
  self.ikd=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
  self.sid=self.m.site('robot_pinch_site').id
  self.qa=np.array([self.m.joint('robot_joint_'+str(i)).qposadr[0] for i in range(1,8)])
  self.ba=np.array([self.m.joint('robot_joint_'+i).qposadr[0] for i in ['x','y','th']])
  self.grip=0; self.success=False
 def pos(self): return self.d.site_xpos[self.sid].copy()
 def rot(self): return self.d.site_xmat[self.sid].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def solve(self,p,R):
  self.ikd.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
  def fun(q):
   self.ikd.qpos[self.qa]=q; mujoco.mj_fwdPosition(self.m,self.ikd)
   pos=self.ikd.site_xpos[self.sid]
   rot=self.ikd.site_xmat[self.sid].reshape(3,3)
   return np.r_[pos-p,Rotation.from_matrix(R@rot.T).as_rotvec()*.25]
  q=self.d.qpos[self.qa].copy()
  res=least_squares(fun,q,max_nfev=50,ftol=1e-7,xtol=1e-7,gtol=1e-7)
  return res.x
 def step(self,q=None,base=None,grip=None):
  a=np.zeros(11)
  if q is not None: a[3:10]=np.clip(q-self.d.qpos[self.qa],-.1,.1)
  if base is not None: a[:3]=np.clip(base-self.d.qpos[self.ba],-.1,.1)
  if grip is not None:self.grip=grip
  a[10]=self.grip
  _,self.success,done=self.s.step(a)
  if self.success:print('SUCCESS',self.s.t,flush=True)
  return done
 def move(self,p,R=None,n=50,tol=.002,base=None,grip=None):
  if R is None:R=self.rot()
  p=np.array(p)
  for i in range(n):
   q=self.solve(p,R)
   if self.step(q,base,grip):break
   err=np.linalg.norm(self.pos()-p); re=np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(R@self.rot().T).as_rotvec())
   if i>5 and err<tol and re<.025:break
  print('move',self.s.t,'target',p,'actual',self.pos(),'error',err,'rot',re,flush=True)
 def line(self,p,R=None,steps=40,base=None,grip=None):
  if R is None:R=self.rot()
  p0=self.pos(); b0=self.d.qpos[self.ba].copy()
  for t in np.linspace(0,1,steps):
   q=self.solve(p0+(np.array(p)-p0)*t,R)
   b=None if base is None else b0+(np.array(base)-b0)*t
   if self.step(q,b,grip):break
  print('line',self.s.t,'actual',self.pos(),flush=True)
 def hold(self,n=10,grip=None):
  q=self.d.qpos[self.qa].copy()
  for _ in range(n):
   if self.step(q,grip=grip):break
 def image(self,name):Image.fromarray(self.s.images(['task_view'])['task_view']).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png')
 def objects(self):
  for n in ['cube_'+str(i) for i in range(5)]+['wiper_0','kitchen_island_drawer_s1c1']:
   b=self.m.body(n).id
   print(n,self.d.xpos[b], 'q',self.d.qpos[self.m.joint(n+'_joint').qposadr[0]],flush=True)
DOWN=np.array([[0,1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,-1.]])
FRONT=np.array([[0,0,-1],[0,1,0],[1,0,0.]])
PY
